stories.headline: Creeper Blast Levels Spawn Bakery
stories.body: A creeper detonated beside the spawn bakery late on Tuesday evening, destroying the east wall and scattering loaves across the square, according to event records. Scribe, who had been tending the ovens, was caught in the blast and later respawned at the town bed. Witnesses reported that the structure had stood since the server’s first week and was a popular meeting place for new arrivals. Rebuilding work began within the hour, with volunteers hauling oak planks from the northern forest. The council has since asked residents to light the area more thoroughly after dark to deter further attacks.

stories.headline: Nether Expedition Returns With Quartz
stories.body: A party of three returned from the Nether on Thursday carrying more than four stacks of quartz and a single ancient debris, the first recorded this season. Expedition leader Steve described the crossing as uneventful apart from a ghast that destroyed part of the return portal frame.

stories.headline: Scribe — 3 deaths
stories.body: Scribe was killed by a creeper near the bakery, drowned in the reservoir, and later fell from the clock tower scaffolding. Mourners laid a single poppy at the town bed.

stories.headline: Herobrine — 1 death
stories.body: Herobrine was slain by a skeleton while crossing the badlands at dusk.

stories.headline: We Need to Go Deeper
stories.body: Alex became the fourth resident to enter the Nether, lighting a portal in the eastern hills on Wednesday morning.

stories.headline: Acquire Hardware
stories.body: Notch smelted iron for the first time, marking the end of a notably long stone age.

stories.headline: Diamonds!
stories.body: Steve struck diamonds at level minus fifty-eight after a three-hour strip mine, and promptly announced it in chat.

stories.headline: Lighthouse Completed at Cape Scribe
stories.body: After nine days of work the stone lighthouse at Cape Scribe was finished on Saturday, its lantern room lit with sea lanterns salvaged from the ocean monument. Builders say the tower can be seen from the spawn docks on a clear night.

stories.headline: Sign Posts
stories.body: Four new signs went up around the market this week, including a welcome notice at the north gate and a warning about the ravine.

stories.headline: Chattiest: Steve
stories.body: Steve sent 212 messages this cycle, comfortably ahead of the field.
